verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a changelog entry saying PgBouncer graphs now sit on their own tab in the Postgres dashboard. That implies PlanetScale runs a managed PgBouncer for Postgres branches, so you would not operate your own. Nothing documents how the pooler is configured or how many connections it handles. Missing for 10: docs describing the built-in pooler and how to connect through it, evidence of handling thousands of concurrent connections, Vitess-side connection handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
